description: Državna mreža potresnih opazovalnic is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by AGENCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA OKOLJE. State network observatories are used to record earthquakes. Data from observatories are collected and processed at the data processing centre at the Environmental Agency of the Republic of Slovenia, the Office for Seismology in Ljubljana. The national network of seismic observatories includes 26 observatories. The file contains information on the location of seismic observatories. Coverage: AGENCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA OKOLJE. The portal shows the English title as "National network of seismic observatories" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is AGENCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA OKOLJE. Its keywords include Naprave in objekti za monitoring okolja, Podatki velike vrednosti. The listing shows 2 download or service links in HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
